title: Unique Paths
inputFormat: Implement uniquePaths(m, n). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return the number of distinct paths as an integer.

visuals.title: Three routes in a 3 × 2 grid
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 420 190" role="img" aria-label="Three paths through a grid with three rows and two columns: right down down, down right down, down down right"><path d="M28 20h80v120h-80z M68 20v120 M28 60h80 M28 100h80" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".25"/><polyline points="48,40 88,40 88,80 88,120" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="48" cy="40" r="5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="88" cy="120" r="6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><text x="68" y="170" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif" font-size="13">R → D → D</text><path d="M168 20h80v120h-80z M208 20v120 M168 60h80 M168 100h80" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".25"/><polyline points="188,40 188,80 228,80 228,120" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="188" cy="40" r="5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="228" cy="120" r="6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><text x="208" y="170" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif" font-size="13">D → R → D</text><path d="M308 20h80v120h-80z M348 20v120 M308 60h80 M308 100h80" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".25"/><polyline points="328,40 328,80 328,120 368,120" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="328" cy="40" r="5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="368" cy="120" r="6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><text x="348" y="170" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif" font-size="13">D → D → R</text></svg>
visuals.caption: R means one step right; D means one step down. Every route starts in the top-left cell and ends in the bottom-right cell.
